cohort: The study included adults (>=18 years) with non-EoE EGIDs and caregivers of children (<18 years) with an EGID as cases, and non-EGID adult controls.
finding: Early life factors, including pregnancy complications, NICU admission, and antibiotics in infancy, were associated with an increased risk of developing non-EoE EGIDs.
followup_time: up to adulthood (18+ years, based on age of cases)
